rv.q: "Baked! The Musical" at Theo Ubique has all the ingredients of a great show—energetic cast, delightful songs and more depth than your typical trope-filled love story.
Baked the Musical is a cute and likable show even if it does have some problems.
The fairest suggestion is that Baked! needs more time in the oven, more seasoning, and a pinch more of this and a dash less of that.
The production now playing is a good beginning for a show that can still use some work.
People going to Baked! should feel good about supporting a work in progress. And that is what they should expect – a work in progress.

One can see that a lot of effort has been placed in this project and that it is headed in a direction that could make it a musical for all people ( although I do not see it as the new "World of Susie Wong" or "Flower Drum Song").
